Always a disappointing experience. Their rotating front desk staff of young women implies a lot about their working conditions too.

I've long ago decided only to use them as an emergency backup, but I wanted to mention that they also don't honour their return policy. Royal Canin has a return policy that if your animal refuses to eat the food, they'll take it back. The vet doesn't even lose money on exchanges, they're just profiteers.

You're much better served at Clinique Vétérinaire Sud-Ouest or Bureau Vétérinaire Griffintown. They're both worth the 15 minute walk, even with big bags of dog food.

the staff is nice but very disorganized and don't follow up even in emergencies. the doctor is straight up mean. avoid this place at all costs. to be clear, it's dr banon that i'm talking about.

update: thank you for removing my last name, doxxing is serious, dr banon. crazy that you could reply to my review the same hour i wrote it but not call back for my cats medical emergency from the meds you just prescribed my cat. you instead want me to pay for another visit? that's insane. My cat is now at a better vet, he doesn't even need 1 unit of medication at a time anymore, the vet didn't need to do plenty of tests and they will prescribe me the human grade one that actually causes much less spikes and is less dangerous. PLUS I can just send the vet an email and they update the meds and give me instructions over email. it's included  in the service. anyone I tell about what you did calls you greedy, including AI. Great Vet that saved my cat from death
The receptionists are very friendly, but Dr. Banon, who is rather dubious, treats you as if he's giving you a consultation; you ask him questions and he laughs at you. He really has no vocation.

I avoided writing this review for a long time because I wanted to believe my previous experiences were isolated incidents. However, after my most recent appointment with Dr. Banon, I feel it is important to share my experience.

I visited the clinic solely to complete the travel documentation for my cat, Cleopatra. Before Dr. Banon entered the room, a staff member reviewed the paperwork I had brought for the process and left the documents on the examination table.

When Dr. Banon came in, he immediately looked at the paperwork, including a copy of my mother's identification, and said, "I don't need all these documents," and then, referring to the ID, "WE ARE NOT IN MEXICO HERE. Put that away and sit down."

I completely understand that certain documents may not have been necessary. My issue was never about that. My issue was the way I was spoken to from the very beginning. The documents were on the table because they had just been reviewed by a member of his staff, not because I was insisting that he use them.

Later, he asked whether I had the microchip documentation. I explained that I did not have a separate certificate because the microchip was implanted on the same day my cat was spayed. While explaining this, I handed him the spay paperwork, which included the microchip number and implantation date. Before allowing me to finish my explanation, he handed the document back and said that it was the spay paperwork and that it was not what he needed.

The frustrating part was that I was specifically trying to explain why I was showing him that document in the first place. I had already told him that I did not have a separate microchip certificate. Instead of listening to my explanation, I felt dismissed before I had even finished speaking. Throughout much of the appointment, I felt as though I was not being listened to.

Unfortunately, this was not the first time I have had a similar experience with Dr. Banon. Over multiple visits, I have encountered the same issues: constant interruptions, little willingness to listen, condescending responses, and an attitude that makes clients feel as though they are asking for a favor rather than paying for a professional service.

What finally pushed me to write this review was realizing that many other clients seem to have had remarkably similar experiences. After reading other reviews, I was surprised to see repeated complaints about poor communication, arrogance, interruptions, and a dismissive attitude toward clients. My experience unfortunately aligns with those reviews.

To be clear, I am not questioning Dr. Banon's medical knowledge. My criticism is entirely about the way he treats people. Communication, empathy, and respect are essential parts of any healthcare profession, including veterinary medicine.

After giving this clinic multiple chances, this appointment was the final straw. I no longer feel comfortable bringing my pets here, and I will not be returning. There are many excellent veterinarians who not only possess strong medical knowledge, but also know how to treat their clients with respect, listen to their concerns, and communicate professionally.
I brought my cat here and loved it. The clinic feels warm and cozy & and the girls at the front are so friendly and professional. The veterinarian and the Vet Tech were great with Kai too!!

I’m very disappointed with my experience. The male doctor did not listen to his patient whatsoever and did not take the time to properly evaluate my dog. During our last appointment, he was visibly sick and kept sneezing throughout the visit, which made the situation feel unprofessional and uncomfortable. No proper assessment was done, yet I was still charged for the appointment.

I left feeling like my concerns were not taken seriously and that my dog did not receive the care he deserved. Unfortunately, we will not be returning. My dog deserves better care and attention.
Impeccable and very humane 💚 …
I always bring my little dog here... The vets are very good! Wouldn't change a thing

2025: had to revisit this vet and saw the same male doctor Mr Banon. I remember that my past experience was terrible but situation forced me to come for a visit that was open. And the doctor is as arrogant as they get. Took majority of examination looking at the screen typing and reviewing technicians noted instead of examining my dog. And when examination started, exited out of the room multiple times and left me to handily my poor anxious sick dog. Finally when he spoke to me, he gave me his speech. I asked a follow up question and simply replied, I have already answered you question before. Just bad communication and ego centric behaviour. This business needs to do something about this. I took the meds and walked out. Please do something. I see many bad reviews regarding Dr Banon and yet, no changes have been made.

Has to be one of the schemiest vets in the city. That vet that gives all other veteranarians a bad name. That vet that is a money greedy private business vet that's pushes drugs on your dog through fear. In this time where you cannot stay with your poor frightened dog in the exam room, you have to give all the information to the technician who than has to relay the information to the doctor so already a broken telephone situation happening here for 100 dollars visit. The doctor than calls you with a speech of the examination and continues to spewl out the different drugs necessary for his infection. He gives instructions on the drugs and when you ask him a question. He rudely tell you all instructions are on the box and continues his speech. He than continues to prescribe another drug to calm my dog down for next time so he can better examine him (he is not aggressive, he was just scared and winning / anxious according to him). When i say no to his drug, and ask him the first question about my dog not related to his prescribed drugs, he rudely tells me that is not what we are talking about. Which gives me an impression of no control of the situation, and makes me more worried about the situation while I am already stressed. I have visited this vet 3 times, and every time I am more stressed out and find my bills an absolute waste of money as the vet can't even take 5 mins to listen to you. Let's be honest here, without verbal information about animals, these pets are very hard to examine. The only reason I made this mistake again is because I wanted to see a vet right away and they had an appointment ready for the next day. Which is usually the case. I can now see the many reasons why this is. Please do not waste your time and money here.
Excellent work

I've been here a few times and saw a female doctor and had a really good experience.

But I just got a chance to meet the male doctor and wow he is a real piece of work. He had an intense and condescending attitude, sternly told me to sit down the moment he entered the room, constantly interrupted me, and wouldn't let me ask any questions. I struggled to properly convey my cat's symptoms because he wouldn't let me finish my sentences. He kept adding more and more things to my bill without explaining to me what they were or why my cat needed them. When I stood up to him and asked him if he could let me finish asking a question he then became angry and raised his voice, all the while the vet tech is just standing in the room looking defeated.

It's hard to imagine any veterinarian correctly treating an animal if they won't listen to their owners talk about their symptoms or ask questions. Beyond that though, I won't be returning because I do not want to interact with this belittling and angry man another time.

Wonderful clinic! Compassionate and professional staff starting with the receptionists to the technicians to the veterinarians, Dr.Banon and Dr.Malakhova who consistently go above and beyond in finding solutions for my dog’s health issues.
Bravo to the Hôpital Vétérinaire Général MB team!

Never trust the price quoted over the phone.
This morning I called to have a document filled out, and the appointment was $105 + tax. I ended up paying an extra $30 to fill out a document!! ($185 total)

The staff was helpful, but a simple "sorry" isn't enough when you pay for a service that isn't even fully completed.

In the end, the document wasn't dated! As a result, I paid double the price, both for canceled appointments (professional or otherwise) and for transportation. Money is good, but good service is better.
Great service. Competent and compassionate vet Darya. Diagnosed and successfully treated my 17-year-old dog without overdoing the tests. I recommended the clinic to other dog owners. Everybody happy.
Avoid at all costs, you will wait an hour or two before you are seen every time.
The vets and staff are friendly and helpful here. The rates are competitively priced and we don't need to wait too long to get an appointment.
Dr. Manuel Banon is very professional, takes his time to explain things thoroughly and answer our questions. Highly recommended!

Every visit was wonderful. My dog, who is very attached to me, adores the staff at this clinic so much that he cries when our vet leaves the room, he loves them so much. The receptionists are so friendly, and it's incredibly easy to get a quick appointment. They are efficient. I highly recommend Dr. Banon, who is very gentle with both the animal and the person accompanying them.
